name: Emby Watch State Migration
description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions from an Emby server into Matinee, per user.
author: Anna Reber

config.label: Emby API key
config.description: Create one under Emby Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys.

config.label: Users to migrate
config.description: Leave empty to migrate every Emby user that matches a Matinee account. Save after changing the selection.

config.label: User mapping overrides
config.description: Comma-separated remoteUser=matineeUser pairs for accounts whose names differ, e.g. john=johnny, kids=children.

config.label: Full sync: mirror the source exactly (may unwatch items in Matinee)
config.description: Off (default): only set watched flags and resume positions, never unwatch.
